apps.name: Steam
apps.summary: Launcher for the Steam software distribution service
apps.description: Steam is the ultimate destination for playing, discussing and creating games. Buy and install thousands of titles, chat with friends and join the community. Proton lets many Windows games run on Linux.

apps.name: SuperTuxKart
apps.description: Race against friends or the computer on dozens of tracks full of shortcuts and power-ups. Play the story mode, battle in arenas or race online. Tux and his friends are ready to go.

apps.name: Luanti
apps.description: Luanti (formerly Minetest) is an open source voxel game engine. Explore, dig and build in endless worlds, play hundreds of community games or host your own multiplayer server.

apps.name: 0 A.D.
apps.description: 0 A.D. is a free historical real-time strategy game of ancient warfare. Build a civilisation, gather resources and lead armies in single player or online matches.

apps.name: OpenTTD
apps.summary: Simulation game based upon Transport Tycoon Deluxe
apps.description: Build a transport empire with trains, road vehicles, ships and aircraft. OpenTTD recreates Transport Tycoon Deluxe with bigger maps, online multiplayer and many improvements.

apps.name: Mines
apps.summary: Clear hidden mines from a minefield
apps.description: The classic puzzle game: uncover the field without stepping on a mine. Numbers show how many mines touch each square. Choose a board size and beat your best time.

apps.name: KPatience
apps.description: KPatience offers more than a dozen solitaire games including Klondike, Spider, FreeCell and Golf. It has hints, unlimited undo and statistics for every game.

apps.name: RetroArch
apps.summary: Frontend for emulators, game engines and media players
apps.description: RetroArch brings classic consoles, arcade machines and game engines together in one app. It supports controllers, shaders, netplay and rewinding.

apps.name: Heroic
apps.summary: Play Epic, GOG and Amazon Games
apps.description: Heroic is an open source launcher for your Epic, GOG and Amazon Prime Gaming libraries. Install, update and play your games with Wine or Proton.

apps.name: Prism Launcher
apps.summary: Custom Minecraft launcher for multiple installations
apps.description: Prism Launcher manages many Minecraft installations at once. Keep separate instances for different versions and mod packs and switch between them in a click.

apps.name: VLC
apps.description: VLC plays almost every video and audio file, discs, webcams and network streams without extra codecs. It is simple, fast and powerful, and it is free.

apps.name: mpv
apps.summary: A free, open source, and cross-platform media player
apps.description: mpv is a lightweight media player with high quality video output and support for a huge range of formats. It is controlled with the keyboard and a minimal on-screen controller.

apps.name: Spotify
apps.description: Listen to millions of songs and podcasts. Create playlists, discover new music made for you and pick up where you left off on any device.

apps.name: Podcasts
apps.description: Subscribe to podcasts from any feed and listen to new episodes as they arrive. Episodes can be streamed or downloaded to listen offline.

apps.name: Shortwave
apps.description: Shortwave gives you access to more than 30,000 internet radio stations. Search for stations, save your favourites to the library and listen with a single tap.

apps.name: Kdenlive
apps.description: Kdenlive is a powerful non-linear video editor. Edit on multiple tracks, add effects and transitions, colour correct your clips and export to many formats.

apps.name: OBS Studio
apps.description: OBS Studio records and streams video with high performance. Combine screens, windows, cameras and images into scenes and switch between them live.

apps.name: Audacity
apps.description: Audacity is an easy to use, multi-track audio editor and recorder. Record live audio, edit sound files, remove noise and apply effects.

apps.name: HandBrake
apps.description: HandBrake converts video from nearly any format to modern, widely supported codecs. Presets make it easy to create files for phones, tablets and the web.

apps.name: GIMP
apps.description: GIMP is a powerful image editor for photo retouching, image composition and artwork. It has layers, masks, filters and support for many file formats.

apps.name: Inkscape
apps.description: Inkscape is a professional vector graphics editor. Create illustrations, logos, diagrams and icons and save them as SVG or export to PNG and PDF.

apps.name: Krita
apps.description: Krita is a professional painting program made by artists. It has brush engines, layers, animation tools and everything you need to paint and draw.

apps.name: darktable
apps.summary: Organize and develop images from digital cameras
apps.description: darktable is a virtual light table and darkroom for photographers. Manage your raw photos and develop them with non-destructive editing tools.

apps.name: Camera
apps.description: Camera takes photos and records videos with your webcam or phone camera. It is simple, touch friendly and shows your latest shots in a gallery.

apps.name: Image Viewer
apps.description: Image Viewer opens your pictures quickly and lets you zoom, rotate and browse through a folder. It supports touch gestures and many image formats.

apps.name: Blender
apps.summary: Free and open source 3D creation suite
apps.description: Blender covers the whole 3D pipeline: modelling, rigging, animation, simulation, rendering, compositing and video editing. It is used for films, games and art.

apps.name: LibreOffice
apps.description: LibreOffice is a complete office suite with a word processor, spreadsheet, presentations, drawing and a database. It opens and saves Microsoft Office documents.

apps.name: ONLYOFFICE
apps.description: ONLYOFFICE Desktop Editors combine text, spreadsheet and presentation editors with high compatibility with Microsoft Office formats. Fill in forms and edit PDF files too.

apps.name: Obsidian
apps.description: Obsidian is a private and flexible note-taking app. Your notes are plain Markdown files on your device, linked together into a knowledge graph.

apps.name: Text Editor
apps.description: Text Editor is a simple editor for notes and documents. It restores your session, saves drafts automatically and supports syntax highlighting.

apps.name: Foliate
apps.description: Foliate is a modern e-book reader for EPUB, Mobipocket and other formats. Choose your theme and layout, add notes and look up words while reading.

apps.name: Okular
apps.description: Okular opens PDF, EPUB, comic books, images and more. Highlight text, add notes and fill in forms on your documents.

apps.name: Calendar
apps.description: Calendar shows your events by month or week and syncs with your online accounts. Add events quickly and never miss an appointment.

apps.name: Xournal++
apps.description: Xournal++ is a handwriting notebook with pen and tablet support. Write notes, sketch and annotate PDF files.

apps.name: Telegram
apps.description: Telegram is a fast and secure messaging app that syncs across all your devices. Send messages, photos and files of any type and join groups and channels.

apps.name: Discord
apps.description: Discord is an all-in-one voice, video and text chat app. Join servers for your communities, hang out with friends and stream your games.

apps.name: Signal
apps.description: Signal is a messaging app with privacy at its core. Messages and calls are end-to-end encrypted and linked to the Signal app on your phone.

apps.name: Element
apps.description: Element is a secure messenger built on the open Matrix network. Chat with end-to-end encryption, make voice and video calls and bridge to other networks.

apps.name: Slack
apps.description: Slack brings team communication together in channels. Message colleagues, share files and connect the tools you use at work.

apps.name: Tuba
apps.description: Tuba is a client for Mastodon and the Fediverse. Read your timelines, post, reply and follow people across the decentralised social web.

apps.name: Firefox
apps.description: Firefox is a fast, private web browser from the non-profit Mozilla. It blocks trackers by default and syncs bookmarks and passwords across your devices.

apps.name: Chromium
apps.summary: The web browser from the Chromium project
apps.description: Chromium is the open source browser that Google Chrome is built on. It is fast, stable and supports a large catalogue of extensions.

apps.name: Brave
apps.summary: Fast internet, ad blocking built in
apps.description: Brave blocks ads and trackers by default to make browsing faster and more private. It is based on Chromium and supports Chrome extensions.

apps.name: Thunderbird
apps.summary: Email, newsfeed, chat and calendaring client
apps.description: Thunderbird manages all your email accounts in one place. It also handles calendars, contacts, news feeds and chat, and it is free and open source.

apps.name: Transmission
apps.summary: Download and share files over BitTorrent
apps.description: Transmission is a simple and lightweight BitTorrent client. It uses few resources and has all the essentials such as magnet links and encryption.

apps.name: LocalSend
apps.description: LocalSend shares files and messages with nearby devices over your local network. It works without an internet connection and across all platforms.

apps.name: Flatseal
apps.description: Flatseal lets you review and change the permissions of your Flatpak apps. Control access to files, devices and the network for every app.

apps.name: Calculator
apps.description: Calculator solves simple sums as well as scientific and financial calculations. It also converts currencies and units.

apps.name: Maps
apps.description: Maps lets you search for places, get directions and explore the world with OpenStreetMap data. Plan routes by car, bike, foot or public transport.

apps.name: Mission Center
apps.description: Mission Center shows the usage of your CPU, memory, disks, network and GPU. See which apps and processes use the most resources and stop them.

apps.name: KeePassXC
apps.description: KeePassXC stores your passwords in an encrypted database that stays on your device. It generates strong passwords and fills them in your browser.

apps.name: Bitwarden
apps.summary: A secure and free password manager
apps.description: Bitwarden stores your logins and passwords securely and syncs them between your devices. Your vault is end-to-end encrypted.

apps.name: Bottles
apps.description: Bottles makes it easy to run Windows programs and games on Linux. It manages Wine environments with ready-made settings for games and software.

apps.name: File Roller
apps.summary: Open, modify and create compressed archives
apps.description: File Roller opens, creates and extracts archives such as zip, tar and 7z. Browse an archive's contents and add or remove files.

apps.name: Clocks
apps.description: Clocks shows the time in cities around the world and has alarms, a stopwatch and timers.

apps.name: Stellarium
apps.description: Stellarium shows a realistic sky in 3D, just like what you see with the naked eye, binoculars or a telescope. Explore stars, planets, nebulae and constellations.

apps.name: Anki
apps.description: Anki makes remembering things easy with spaced repetition flash cards. Study languages, medicine, music or anything else and sync your decks.

apps.name: GeoGebra
apps.description: GeoGebra combines geometry, algebra, graphing, statistics and calculus in one easy to use app. Explore mathematics interactively.

apps.name: GCompris
apps.description: GCompris is a suite of more than 100 educational activities for children aged 2 to 10. Learn reading, counting, science, geography and more through play.

apps.name: Marble
apps.description: Marble is a virtual globe and world atlas. Explore maps of the Earth, the Moon and the planets, measure distances and look up places.

apps.name: Tux Paint
apps.description: Tux Paint is a drawing program for young children with a playful interface, sound effects and a cartoon mascot. Draw with brushes, stamps and magic tools.

apps.name: VSCodium
apps.description: VSCodium is a community build of Visual Studio Code without Microsoft branding and telemetry. Edit code in any language with extensions from Open VSX.

apps.name: Visual Studio Code
apps.description: Visual Studio Code is a lightweight but powerful source code editor. It has IntelliSense, debugging, Git integration and thousands of extensions.

apps.name: Builder
apps.description: Builder is an IDE for creating GNOME applications. It has project templates, Flatpak integration, a debugger and code completion.

apps.name: Godot Engine
apps.description: Godot is a feature-packed open source game engine. Create 2D and 3D games with a unified interface and export them to many platforms.

apps.name: GitHub Desktop
apps.description: GitHub Desktop makes working with Git repositories simple. Commit, branch, review changes and open pull requests without the command line.

apps.name: Meld
apps.description: Meld compares files and folders side by side and helps you merge changes. It works with Git and other version control systems.
